title: Interoperability and Cross-chain communication for Cardano: VISTA (Verified Interchain Secure Transfer Architecture)

ms.promise:
The goal of VISTA is to create a bridged sidechain ecosystem and protocol for the Cardano network that can extend between Cardano-based chains and beyond. As a first output and to help steer the rest of the developmental roadmap we will publish initial design and architecture documentation and roadmap.
・VISTA Protocol Design Documentation: Detailed documentation outlining the protocol design and architecture vision as well as laying the groundwork for the development roadmap to help the team accomplish the mission.
・GitHub and YouTube Progress Updates: The team will publish YouTube progress videos as well as GitHub repositories related to both the Design Documentation to be released as part of this milestone but also documenting progress on the various modules to be released as part of subsequent milestones.

GitHub Repository Overview

・Cardano Indexer: Also known as the "Watcher," this module observes the Cardano blockchain and initiates actions based on detected activities..
・Cardano Mirror: This module reflects the activities recorded by the Indexer onto the destination chain, effectively replicating transactions and updates across blockchain environments.
・Cardano Relayer: The bridge between Indexers and Mirrors, handling the relay of event messages to ensure smooth and secure communication across components.

GitHub: https://github.com/vista-foundation/design-docs

Resubmission 
We are resubmitting this milestone because the prior refusal was based on a clarification question that was not directly related to the milestone criteria. As such, the grounds for refusal do not reflect an evaluation of the deliverables themselves.
We kindly request that reviewers take into account the full scope of the proposal when assessing milestones. If clarification is required, we encourage the use of the discussion tab for questions, rather than issuing a non-approval.

Clarification
The reviewer’s question was: “At what stage of the implementation will the project address bridging between Cardano and a non-Cardano blockchain…”
This point is explicitly addressed in Milestone 4, which outlines the development of the Relayer module. The Relayer is the third essential component of any blockchain bridge, designed to pass messages between Indexers and Mirrors, including across blockchains.
Furthermore, the milestone specifies that the Relayer will support Cardano <=> Agrologos communication. Agrologos is a permissions-based blockchain under development, derived from Cardano. This directly addresses the cross-chain bridging aspect raised by the reviewer.
We respectfully request that this milestone be reviewed based on the deliverables and outputs provided, which are aligned with the Statement of Milestones (SoM).

Response to Admin Feedback
The accepted milestone criteria stated: "The reviewer will be able to watch a video showcasing the working Mirror software." This requirement specifies only that the Mirror software be shown working, which the original submission fulfilled. Nevertheless, to accommodate the Admin Team's request for unique evidence, we have produced a new video which was screen recorded by a separate member of our team.
The module is capable of:
・Receiving indexer-derived messages and validating their schema and provenance.
・Transforming those messages into destination-chain for the Relayer.
・Enforcing guardrails such as idempotency/replay protection and rules checks to ensure intents are safe and reproducible.

ms.promise:
Originally the proposal had 6 milestones listed. In order to consolidate down to the 5 required by the Catalyst tool, we have merged portions of Milestone #5 (VISTA Testing and Optimization) with Milestone #4 (this) and the Final Closeout milestone. The output of this milestone will be the third piece of software necessary to facilitate the full deployment of the bridge (sans UI/UX) to be further tested, optimized, and improved during the final milestone (closeout).
The third component of any blockchain bridge is the "Relayer" that serves to pass messages back and forth between one or more Indexers and Mirrors. This module should be capable of receiving messages from an indexer and issuing messages to a mirror on Cardano networks (Cardano <=> Agrologos).
・Vista Module 3 "Cardano Relayer": Release an initial alpha version of the Cardano Relayer Module
・Module should be capable of successfully listening to events from an Indexer Module and issuing events to a Mirror Module

Project Closeout POA

The following is our project closeout submission for Project Catalyst proposal 1100169.
For this final milestone, we completed the project closeout documentation and prepared the required closeout materials. We also addressed remaining documentation gaps and published the relevant bridge source code, backend components, UI updates, tests, and technical documentation to GitHub.
As part of the final project work, the Vista Bridge now includes support for bridging ETH on Ethereum Sepolia with vETH on Cardano Preprod. This gives the Cardano community a working open-source foundation for building a functional cross-chain bridge, including backend services, frontend wallet flow, configuration examples, integration tests, and developer documentation.
Recent repository updates confirm the ETH bridge work has been added to main, including:
・Ethereum bridge documentation: https://github.com/vista-foundation/bridge/blob/main/docs/ethereum-bridge.md
・EVM mirror service: https://github.com/vista-foundation/bridge/tree/main/offchain/src/evm-mirror
・EVM indexer service: https://github.com/vista-foundation/bridge/tree/main/offchain/src/evm-indexer
・Main GitHub repository: https://github.com/vista-foundation/bridge

The GitHub history also shows recent main branch activity, including the May 21, 2026 merge of PR #4, followed by commits adding the ETH Sepolia to Cardano Preprod bridge, EVM source-chain support, destination-wallet UI, and E2E testing.
